name: cua-hard/halvorsen-plateful-pricefile
description: Load a supplier's corrected 2027 price list into a bakery group's recipe-costing system: download the Halvorsen Mill & Pantry rev B list from Gmail, transform it locally (dedupe by latest Revised line, price basis to case price, imperial to metric, map to Airtable item codes, drop inactive/discontinued/contract-protected items and the look-alike dairy supplier), upload the CSV as an attachment from the old Yahoo account to Plateful's current private import address, and record discontinued items, price-review flags and the effective date in Airtable.

metadata.subscenario: 采购分析师把供应商新价目表转换后导入配方成本系统并维护 Airtable 物料主数据
